name: Ashton Ward
headline: QA Automation Engineer I · Staff Sergeant (E-6) · Infrastructure & Automation
summary: Quality assurance automation engineer with experience validating interconnected payment applications, testing REST APIs, building TCP-based test utilities, and reproducing defects across software and network boundaries. My civilian work centers on functional testing, automation, and release validation.

Staff Sergeant in the Arkansas Army National Guard, serving in network and communications systems since January 2019. My background also includes university help desk and healthcare IT internships, a B.S. in Computer Science with a Cybersecurity & Privacy option, and CompTIA Security+ certification. Outside work, I build and document infrastructure using Proxmox, Linux, Cisco networking, OPNsense, Ansible, and GitHub Actions.

experience.title: QA Automation Engineer I
bullets: Validate a suite of more than 30 interconnected applications in cloud-integrated and network-connected payment environments, checking application behavior and interactions across releases.
Perform REST API and backend validation using Postman and Python; compare expected behavior with actual responses and transaction flows.
Develop TCP-based payment-device test utilities and message-relay services to support PIN-pad simulator testing and repeatable automated scenarios.
Work with message buffers, transaction-protocol behavior, and test data while building software that supports the testing of other software.
Support functional and automated testing workflows, including Ranorex-based testing and custom simulator utilities.
Investigate failures using application behavior and firewall logs; reproduce defects, document the conditions that trigger them, and communicate findings for correction.
Execute test suites and validate changes as software moves from QA toward Alpha; use version and release information to understand which application builds are under test.

experience.title: Staff Sergeant (E-6) · 25H Network Communication Systems Specialist
experience.schedule: Part-time military service · recurring drill and annual training
bullets: Support the setup, operation, and troubleshooting of tactical network and communications systems during military training and exercises.
Configure and support routers, managed switches, and communications equipment; investigate connectivity problems and restore communications within the assigned environment.
Work with Cisco networking equipment and Dell PowerEdge server platforms supporting virtualized and networked systems.
Lead and coordinate network-team tasks, provide technical assistance, and help team members operate and troubleshoot assigned equipment.
Maintain equipment accountability and follow procedures for handling sensitive information and communications equipment.
Apply experience with routing, switching, and network connectivity while working within a military communications team.

experience.title: IT Help Desk
bullets: Support campus users with computer, printer, software, and workstation troubleshooting through help desk requests.
Deploy preconfigured Windows images using a boot drive, then prepare computers and install required software for campus use.
Assist with workstation upgrades and replacements, software installation, and hardware setup.
Support backup and upgrade preparation, printer maintenance, and workstation cabling.
Use ticketing and asset-management tools, including Lansweeper, to support service requests and equipment visibility.

experience.title: Information Technology Intern
bullets: Verify backups before workstation upgrades and replacements as part of preparation for IT changes.
Prepare approximately 12 Windows computers concurrently, installing software and readying workstations for deployment.
Replace workstations, organize and connect cabling, and assist with endpoint setup in a healthcare environment.
Troubleshoot and maintain printers and support routine user-facing hardware issues.
Assist with network connectivity and static IP configuration, structured cabling, and installation or relocation of security cameras.
